integrity: The trichotomy is proved for all stated integer parameters; finite integer checks are supplementary and are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only blow-ups of complete rectangular Cartesian grids of distinct points on P1 x P1 with at least three points in each factor are classified.
No conclusion is asserted for arbitrary point configurations or the full effective cone.
Literature comparison does not constitute independent originality certification.
title: The anticanonical trichotomy for rectangular grid blow-ups
